cmake_minimum_required (VERSION 2.6)
project (CrabsTK)
# Autogenerated by SyncSeams.py -- do not edit by hand.
# One .cpp = one binary. The main entry is _Seams.cpp (this directory);
# each module also gets a standalone binary from <Mod>/_Seams.cpp.
get_filename_component (CRABSTK_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.." ABSOLUTE)
get_filename_component (CRABSTK_PARENT "${CRABSTK_ROOT}/.." ABSOLUTE)

# Main binary: the full test tree.
file (MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file (WRITE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/_Seams.cpp"
  "// Generated by CMake. Single-TU wrapper.\n"
  "#include \"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/_Seams.cpp\"\n")
add_executable(CrabsTK "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/_Seams.cpp")
target_include_directories(CrabsTK PRIVATE
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
  "${CRABSTK_ROOT}"
  "${CRABSTK_PARENT}/ASCIICrabs"
  "${CRABSTK_PARENT}"
)
set_target_properties(CrabsTK PROPERTIES
  CXX_STANDARD 23
  CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
  CXX_EXTENSIONS ON
)
